text:
Lina M: Quick thought — can we try a 2-lane triage next week? one lane for urgent bugs (<24h) and one for backlog grooming. Keeps the call short. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj P: +1, we've been piling minor stuff. How long for each lane? 15m + 30m?
Marco: I'd prefer 10m urgent, 20m backlog. Owners can pre-mark items with tags `urgent`/`groom`.
Jules: Can we add "RFC quick reviews" as a 5m slot for new PRs that need attention? Saves a separate meeting.
Lina M: Good idea. Proposal: Tue 30m total — 10m urgent, 15m backlog, 5m RFC quick hits. Owners for urgent=oncall, backlog=rotating owners. Agree? :+1:
Raj P: Agree, but oncall might be busy. Suggest fallback owner list. I'll draft a rota.
oncall-bot: Reminder configured: triage-call Tuesdays 10:00 UTC -> channel #eng-triage
Marco: Also can we try alternating weeks with a "deep-dive" backlog every other Thursday? Keep Tue light.
Lina M: Sounds fine. Action items: @Raj P create rota, @Marco update calendar as recurring 30m, @Jules add RFC quick review template to docs.
Raj P: I'll set the rota and ping owners. Also, can we add a tiny pre-read doc link?
Jules: I'll add a checklist snippet:
```
- add title + PR link
- short 2-line problem
- owner
- desired outcome
```
Lina M: Perfect. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll flip calendar and try next Tue. :calendar:
Marco: No objections from me.
Jules: fine here.
Raj P: looks good — will do.
Lina M: Thanks everyone — closing thread. :rocket:
